_comment: Pins for the cloudflared binary a FUTURE tunnel test would use. Nothing is pinned yet: version and every sha256 are null, so scripts/cloudflared_pin.py REFUSES to download or approve any binary. To pin (a separate, reviewed step before Stage 4B): choose a release, take the SHA-256 of each asset from the official release page, verify it independently a second time, then fill the values in and commit them for review. Never pin a hash computed from a binary you have not otherwise verified.
